name: gh-review-pr
description: Review GitHub pull requests on the first pass or after updates and prepare evidence-backed feedback.

interface.shortDescription: Initial and follow-up PR reviews with safe feedback
interface.longDescription: Review a GitHub pull request from scratch or verify fixes after earlier feedback. The workflow prioritizes evidence-backed defects, avoids duplicate comments, and requires confirmation before posting reviews.
defaultPrompt: Review this pull request and prepare evidence-backed comments
Re-review this pull request and verify the previous feedback
